description: This file implements parts of the DataElement class, including CRC32 calculation, buffer access, and copy functionality, within the WPEFramework core namespace.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with methods for checksum calculation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Represents a linked list of data buffers with methods for buffer management and copying.

methods.name: DataElement::CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified buffer segment.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::GetBuffer
methods.description: Reads a segment of data into a buffer, potentially spanning multiple linked buffer nodes.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::SetBuffer
methods.description: Writes a segment of data from a buffer into the linked buffer structure.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another LinkedDataElement into this one, starting at a specified offset.

methods.name: uint32_t CRC32(const uint64_t offset,const uint64_t size) const
uint64_t Copy(const uint64_t offset,const LinkedDataElement & copy)
void GetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,uint8_t * buffer) const
void SetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,const uint8_t * buffer)
